description: deixis mandatory Node[T] mapping vectors — map of ADR 0010 §4: map(f,Node(t,m)) = Node(f(t), {k ↦ map(f,m[k])}). f is applied at every node, and the domain is unchanged. The named functions (id, class-suffix-x, representation-upper, none-to-z, option-map-class-suffix-x, wrap-in-array) are defined in vectors/MNODE-PLAN.md. "f" as a list applies each function in order. op "at-after-map" asserts at(map(f,n),p) with equal definedness. Every case declares its slot. Hand-authored from docs/design/0010-mandatory-node-values.md, docs/TREE.md and docs/PATH.md as merged in 1a9bb6d, and from nothing else. No implementation of the mandatory API existed when these were written. Items X5 and X6; each note names the defect (W) it catches. 11 cases.

cases.name: m-map-applies-at-every-node
cases.note: X5. The function reaches the root (r), the interior node (i) and both terminals (t, s). ADR 0010 §4: mapping visits the own value of every node. Catches W4 (skipping the root or interior nodes).

cases.name: m-map-on-a-childless-root
cases.note: X5. A single childless node is mapped too. Catches an implementation that maps only below the root.

cases.name: m-map-invisible-to-equality-gives-equal-tree
cases.note: X5. f respects ≈ and changes only what ≈ ignores, so map(f,n) ≡ n under the lifted identity (TREE, 'Setoids ride along').

cases.name: m-map-domain-unchanged-with-empty-and-non-utf8-keys
cases.note: X5. D_map(f,n) = D_n: keys are untouched, including the empty key and a non-UTF-8 key; only values move.

cases.name: m-map-twice
cases.note: X5. map(g,map(f,n)) ≡ map(g∘f,n): each node is mapped exactly once per pass, never skipped and never doubled.

cases.name: m-map-at-after-map-missing
cases.note: X5. Both sides of the law have equal definedness: [62] is missing before mapping and after it (TREE: (map f N)/p is defined exactly when N/p is).

cases.name: m-map-option-generic-changes-none
cases.note: X6. Generic map applies f to the whole payload at every node, none included: ADR 0010 §4, 'For T = Option[A], generic mapping may transform None'. The root and the interior node [62] carried none and now carry some(z). Catches W4 (skipping none payloads).

cases.name: m-map-option-map-specialization-keeps-none
cases.note: X6. The presence-preserving mapping is the explicit specialization map(Option.map(f),n): none stays none, and each some is mapped inside. Paired with m-map-option-generic-changes-none: the same tree gives different results for the two functions, so an implementation that folds them into one fails one case of the pair.

cases.name: m-map-json-reaches-null-payloads
cases.note: X5. The null payloads at the root and at [61] are values, so f reaches them: null ↦ [null]. Catches W4 (null read as absence and skipped).
